name: gsd-whisper
description: Shows you what gsd-core's hooks quietly tell the agent: context warnings, guard advice and guard denials.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on start
openOnStart.description: Dock the GSD whispers pane when a session starts in a GSD project (fullscreen layout only). Off by default: the history is empty until a hook speaks. /gsd-whisper opens it either way.
